Monday Moves (District Cycling Collective)

Washington, DC · Navy Yard · Road · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Monday Moves (District Cycling Collective) is a road and social group ride in Washington, DC. It rolls every Monday at 10:15 am from Conte's Bike Shop Navy Yard. About 18–30 miles, casual, geared to newer riders. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:15 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual, geared to newer riders. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @districtcyclingcollective the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Monday Moves (District Cycling Collective) group ride

A weekday-morning city tour from Conte's in Navy Yard. Routes hit the monuments or run the trails out to National Harbor. Built for newer riders, nobody gets left behind. The same group also runs a faster Wednesday paceline in Anacostia Park.
